meaning: At most one successful finalized mint per exact definition-version commitment within this Product on Solana devnet, across sharing users. A repeated request returns the existing result; another user cannot mint a second copy under this rule. Never automatically create a replacement mint transaction. An uncertain outcome blocks another attempt until reconciliation proves no mint succeeded. A proven failed attempt requires a fresh user confirmation before retry. No burns, replacements or successor mints in v1.
source_or_proposal: New local proposal; not a recovered source declaration.
